findings.highlight: oddly sharp when it comes to picking up details
findings.evidenceJa: 細かいコトには妙に神経質なヤツ
findings.governingReading: Taiga teases Shirou for being unusually fussy or sensitive about small details, explaining why he noticed Sakura's extra rice.
findings.explanation: Taiga's teasing description of Shirou's fussiness becomes praise of his sharp observation. His noticing Sakura's habit remains intact.
